items.label: 7 SEATS FUNCTIONAL PATIO FURNITURE SET
items.value: Includes 2 swivel patio glider chairs, 2 multifunctional ottomans, 1 three-seater wicker outdoor couch, and 1 tempered glass-top table. Perfect for gardens, balconies, poolside, and patios to create a cozy social and relaxing zone

items.label: ALL-WEATHER PE RATTAN & RUST-PROOF FRAME
items.value: This wicker rattan patio furniture set made from THICKENED 3D-TEXTURED PE RATTAN that's fade-resistant, crack-proof, and UV-protected for a longer-lasting look. Rustproof steel frame with PHI VILLA advanced E-COATING & POWDER COATING shields against rain, sun, and corrosion. Easy to clean and maintain, no special care needed, built for all-weather use

items.label: 360°Smooth Swivel & Gentle Glide
items.value: The sturdy round metal base allows for 360°effortless rotation & 30°smooth gliding, providing safer and more flexible movement than standard rocking chairs. With a gentle push, the patio chair glides back and forth in a soothing rhythm, offering plush comfort—perfect for reading, napping, or relaxing with friends

items.label: Cloud-Like Comfort & Ergonomic Support
items.value: Enjoy exceptional comfort with 24"x24"oversized seat cushions filled with 4”thick high-density memory foam. The outdoor rattan sofa set combination of plush support, a high backrest, and wide, curved armrests provides full ergonomic relaxation—perfect for long hours of lounging

items.label: CUSHION PRO technology & Weather-Resistant Olefin Fabric
items.value: wicker outdoor funiture set crafted with premium Olefin fabric enhanced by CUSHION PRO technology: water and oil resistant, UV-resistant, and easy to clean. The breathable, fade-resistant material ensures long-lasting beauty and performance in all seasons
